scope: Sports semantic, source catalog, data-grain, capability routing, spatial/time and dense-storage contract above the accepted scientific core.

authorities: AlgorithmSpec parameters hash code SHA and input checksums
rules: sports entities are an overlay and never rename the scientific core
a Session is not a Contest
dense telemetry never moves to PostgreSQL
rights and provenance remain first-class

contest_rules: contest references one Sport and a CompetitionEdition only when source authority establishes it
home/away is represented only when declared by that sport/source
contest periods retain source numbering and labels
roster membership reuses the existing dataset-scoped Subject identity

provider_identity_crosswalk.merge_rule: Display-name equality never merges entities. Heuristics may propose a mapping; a deterministic identifier or explicit mapping authority is required to accept it.

data_grain.rule: A declared grain's complete axes form the row key; every axis is present and non-null, and duplicate keys are rejected before publication.

rules: catalog discovery is metadata-only
upstream availability is not a Session
local readiness is separate from upstream capability
failed states retain their failure stage and evidence
promotion to Bronze requires deterministic acquisition checks
profiles are derived deterministically from registered streams, artifacts, catalog evidence and accepted processors
upstream and local capabilities are reported separately
MODEL_ESTIMATED remains explicit
provider name never selects a product

requires_local_capabilities: FORCE or IMU or LPT or GNSS

rules: source event type is retained
sport/provider attributes validate against a versioned schema
location requires a declared SpatialReference
canonical event-family normalization is optional and versioned
provider coordinates remain recoverable
no sport is normalized to a football pitch
transforms are explicit and versioned
a sport adapter declares a versioned mapping to canonical t_rel_ns
countdown clocks do not imply monotonic time
SkillCorner Basketball acceptance preserves 25 fps wall time, period, countdown game clock and shot clock

storage.semantic_authority: PostgreSQL stores semantic, catalog, provenance and Gold metadata only.
storage.dense_authority: Immutable Parquet/Arrow artifacts in object storage; DuckDB and PyArrow remain the initial read plane.

artifact_boundaries.EVENT_SERIES: season or release-scale file with contest/period/sequence columns
artifact_boundaries.PLAY_BY_PLAY: season or release-scale file with contest/period/sequence columns

partition_rules: partition only where it materially prunes reads
avoid player/event high-cardinality directories and tiny files
retain row-group statistics and projection/predicate pushdown

adoption_triggers: table snapshots independent of artifact/run identity
plain-file manifest planning becomes a measured bottleneck

openlineage_export.authority: Dynamis provenance remains authoritative; OpenLineage is an export-compatible mapping.

sports: baseball when explicit source metadata declares it
contest_context_sources: skillcorner-opendata when match metadata declares facts
womens-soccer-positioning only at the declared matchday scope
rules: retain existing Subject identities
provider IDs enter only as crosswalk aliases
do not invent competition, edition, team, contest or period facts
catalog can list registered sources without acquiring files

steps: add additive PostgreSQL semantic/catalog tables and grain metadata
backfill explicit source facts and synchronize catalog metadata
run full migration and current-product regression suites

acceptance: migration is additive and preserves existing rows
SkillCorner/DFL facts can map through the sports overlay without renaming Session
catalog separates upstream and local readiness
football and basketball spatial/time contracts are representable
no dense telemetry is placed in PostgreSQL
current MatchLab and laboratory regression suites remain green
